d:
Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri achanak nitish setu ka jayja lene pahunche. is dauran unhonne setu ki taiyariyon aur vyavasthaon ka nirikshan kiya aur pradhanmantri narendr modi ke prastavit karyakram ko lekar bhi jankari di. aakhir nitish setu ko lekar kya hai taiyari aur piem modi ka karyakram kab ho sakta hai? dekhie puri riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
